issues.title: Add a --drafts flag to `tinsel serve`
issues.body:
When I preview locally I want to see my draft posts too. Right now I have to flip `draft: true` to false, look at it, and flip it back.

Proposal: `tinsel serve --drafts` includes drafts in the dev server only. `tinsel build` would keep ignoring them.

issues.title: Code blocks lose highlighting when the language name is uppercase
issues.body:
A fence like ```Python renders as plain text, while ```python is highlighted. Looks like the lexer lookup is case sensitive.

tinsel 0.9.1, macOS 14. Minimal post:

    ```Python
    print('hi')
    ```

Expected: highlighted. Actual: plain `<pre>`.
issues.author: devon-ash

issues.title: RSS feed shows post dates shifted by one day
issues.body:
Posts dated `2026-01-08` in front matter show up as Jan 7 in my feed reader (I'm in Chicago).

feed.xml contains `<pubDate>Thu, 08 Jan 2026 00:00:00 +0000</pubDate>`. Since the time is midnight UTC, anyone west of UTC sees the previous day. The site itself shows the right date.

Maybe use the `timezone` from tinsel.toml, or noon, when the front matter has no time? tinsel 0.9.2.
